prompts: Create ONE production-ready RGBA UI icon ATLAS, a precise 4 by 4 grid of 16 independent centered icons, truly transparent background, all cells exactly equal. No text, labels, numbers, frames, visible checkerboard or divider lines. Each icon fits entirely inside its cell with 15 percent empty padding; never touches neighboring cell. Style: Touhou-inspired shrine danmaku fantasy, delicate gouache illustration, clean dark indigo edges, ivory paper highlights, restrained vermilion, ice cyan and antique gold. Readable distinctive silhouettes at 48 pixels, not photoreal, no sci-fi holograms, no realistic weapons, no vast glow clouds. Only pictorial symbols. ROW 2: (5) small gold CLOCK FACE without numbers, two red rapid arrowheads for attack speed; (6) amber crystal surrounded by four cyan arrows pointing INWARD for pickup radius; (7) green budding leaf with a cream healing droplet for regeneration; (8) a red shrine charm with two long blue arrows pointing OUTWARD to either side for attack range. ROW 3: (9) sharp cyan ICICLE with two elongated gold speed streaks for projectile speed; (10) THREE cyan icicles arranged as a fan for ice shot count; (11) blue hexagonal shield DEFLECTING a vermilion arrow for damage reduction; (12) large layered blue-and-gold hexagonal shield with stacked inner plates for armor capacity. ROW 4: (13) faceted purple-cyan spirit crystal with a pair of small gold stars for experience gain; (14) THREE silver crescent throwing blades orbiting a faint indigo arc for blade count; (15) THREE orange flaming fireballs arranged as a fan for fireball count; (16) THREE violet four-point stars each with a short parallel laser beam for laser count. Avoid combining cells. All 16 icons use the same elegant hand-painted illustration vocabulary and transparent alpha.
